what: P5 rev 2 proposal: a Covenant green that cannot be confused with the Warden green. Ronja decided the Warden stays green.
status: proposal, awaiting Ronja's decision (no other worker's files were changed)

warden.note: unchanged olive-moss green. Rev 2 drops the g highlight from the Warden (NES n + G only), so the Warden never uses a Covenant key.

covenantToday.problem: sage green, hue 126 deg vs the Warden 97 deg; dE to the Warden ramp per step [6.5, 11.6, 16.7, 13.1, 17.9, 26.0] (min 10.6 over the mid/light steps), and both use NES G.

covenantProposed.name: Covenant jade

nesSwaps.note: replace every G in the Covenant mappings with t (shade) or g (body); l = light, b = optional single glint.

covenantProposed.why: moves the Covenant to a cool blue-green (jade / ivy) with more saturation, while the Warden keeps the warm olive moss. At 16-bit the hue gap is 60 degrees and the closest mid/light steps are 20.6 dE apart (today: 10.6); at 8-bit the two share no key (Warden n/G, Covenant t/g/l), so a Covenant patrol can never read as the hero.
covenantProposed.usedBy: P5 Mossweave Cowl hood layer (items.hood.mossweave, 7 steps) already uses hood7 + t/g/l, so the Covenant piece reads as Covenant.
covenantProposed.brief: ART-BRIEF says "Covenant: moss green hoods". With the Warden in moss green, this proposal changes the Covenant to jade green hoods (still forest green, still Covenant), which needs Ronja's OK.

toApply: optional: biome/flag colours that use G for the Covenant (units.js patrol_covenant flag "g" is already fine)
